scope: Integrated long-page rendering containment, five common-site rules and conservative dirty-subtree owner discovery
method: Archive the integrated main baseline in a separate temporary directory, reuse the same installed dependencies, run resource-safe WXT prepare and the official userscript build, then compare exact artifact bytes and SHA256. The budget uses the smallest whole 1000-byte increment that admits the measured candidate. Protocol, duplicate-injection, grant and execution-boundary checks are unchanged.
limitations: The delta includes this task's long-page work as well as the new site rules and owner fix; it is not the isolated cost of any one rule.
Userscript build and verifier acceptance do not establish userscript-manager runtime acceptance.

finalIntegration.method: Repeat the independent archive/prepare/build/verifier comparison on current main with identical dependencies. Preserve the previous integration record above; the same minimal 2033000-byte budget admits this candidate. Source comment compaction does not change executable code; final build hashes are checked against the browser-tested artifact.

discourseMainIntegration.method: Repeat the independent archive/prepare/build/verifier comparison on the integrated discourse-context main with identical dependencies. Preserve all earlier integration records; the budget uses the smallest whole 1000-byte increment that admits the candidate. Protocol and execution-boundary checks are unchanged.
